description:
Calculate the hydraulic properties table for the most upstream cross-section in the Muncie HEC-RAS project. 

Goal: Write a Python script to parse the geometry data (Muncie.g04 or HDF), identify the cross-section with the highest River Station value (most upstream), and compute hydraulic properties at 0.5-ft elevation increments from the thalweg (minimum elevation) to the maximum ground elevation.

Required Outputs:
1. A CSV file at '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/hydraulic_properties.csv' containing the following columns:
   - Elevation_ft
   - Area_sqft (Cross-sectional flow area)
   - WettedPerimeter_ft
   - HydraulicRadius_ft (Area / Wetted Perimeter)
   - TopWidth_ft

2. A summary text file at '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/cross_section_summary.txt' containing:
   - The River Station identifier
   - Number of station-elevation points in the geometry
   - Thalweg elevation
   - Maximum elevation

You must implement the geometric calculations (area, perimeter, width) yourself using the station-elevation data found in the project files.
